The lowest matching sequence decides. inspect tracks and allows the return traffic; permit allows without a session; deny blocks new connections, but the return traffic of an inspected session still passes. Without a rule, traffic between zones, or between a zone and an interface without a zone, is dropped. Within the same zone and between interfaces without a zone, it is allowed. Related ICMP errors go through the same ACLs and deny rules. The router itself uses the ACLs.

LACP negotiates members with control frames. Active starts; passive answers. At least one side must be active. Mode on bundles without negotiation and needs on at both ends. The port-channel load-balance hash (src-dst-ip by default on switches) picks a member; a failure redistributes the flows among the remaining ones.
